snippet.title: It Takes A Tribe - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
ITAT is a single-player strategy set in a harsh and mythical world before cities and civilization. Lead a tribe of hunter-gatherers to fulfil their destiny. Survive, explore, craft, perform rituals, design art and forge a cultural identity. What stories will your tribe tell?

Visit our Steam page for more!
